test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FIXED' is written as 'XIFED' and 'MOUSE' is written as 'USOME'. How will 'GAMBIT' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48003724b8dc424c58c45f2d138ed98998a90c88e3918b7aff60b440b4ab1b52.png] 

The logic followed here is-

 
• **All the letters are rearranged according to their position values in descending order.**

So,

 
• 'FIXED' is coded as :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591018ecee01feab200477e5344da3c5e3f7c5b7d1bfb34e6a456ce94a449298.png] 

 
• 'MOUSE' is coded as :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7c73bd18c8ba2b4b1393f2ac3a8fd7e7b1d062077a3b40495152d385a111028.png] 

Similarly, 

 
• 'GAMBIT' is coded as:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35360ddb35e4ea42b5a6e058b8170eb4265226079698194832ea51b9e95ae89f.png] 

Here, 'GAMBIT' is written as TMIGBA.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****TMIGBA"**.
